description: The board reads a resuming driver performs: /session cont Step 0-1, then the /kb-att lane read, then the claim-candidates and cold-start packet reads from the kb skill. Every read is read-only on the board and returns --json.

reads.source: session/SKILL.md:206 (`kb-remote ws ls --json`, registry discovery before PROJECT is known)
reads.consumed: name, rootPath of every row (session/SKILL.md:283-299 resolves PROJECT from the row whose rootPath prefixes the worktree)

reads.source: session/SKILL.md:722 (`handoff list --status pending --json`; no --to, see the comment above it). The served binary has no --limit on handoff list; ADR-037 says it must grow one before it can refuse.
reads.consumed: id, to, branch, repoPath, dirtySummary, headSha of the lane's or unaddressed rows (session/SKILL.md:725-740)

reads.source: session/SKILL.md:810 (`attention list --status open --json`); --limit 100 is the default that call relied on, passed explicitly per ADR-037

array length; rows only when non-empty (session/SKILL.md:822-829)
rows whose raisedBy ends in @LANE or whose taskID is in the lane (lane-att.sh:101-103); id set for O(1) membership (lane-att.sh:91)
newest 200 rows projected to id, kind, taskID, raisedBy, resolvedBy, resolvedAt, body[0:300], resolution[0:300] (lane-att.sh:131-135); id set (lane-att.sh:92)

id -> {title,status,lane,priority} index (lane-att.sh:87-88); lane rows projected to id,title,status,lane,priority,tags (lane-att.sh:124-125); blocked lane rows (lane-att.sh:104); drafts (lane-draft-classify.jq). The full list never crosses the wire in the deployed script (lane-att.sh:50-52).
